verdict.rationale: Codex generates AI-driven insights and suggestions specifically about a user's codebase — prioritized review findings, diffs, summaries, and follow-up suggestions (codex-docs-5, codex-docs-9, codex-docs-10) — which counts as 'insights from data' in the coding-agent sense, though 'data' here is limited to source code/repos rather than broader business or product data. Missing for 10: evidence of insight generation over non-code data sources, and independent/hands-on validation that these suggestions are consistently high-quality (community comments are mixed on reliability, e.g. codex-comm-3, codex-comm-13).
